# 灰树脂图生图提示词

选择一个开头，再附通用正文；输入已经明确要求其他姿态/构图时替换相应句子。不要把两个互相冲突的模式同时发送。以下是参考图的视觉目标，并非真实网格拓扑保证。

## 单图开头

> Edit the supplied portrait into a finely sanded, cast neutral-gray resin head sculpture, shown straight-on at eye level. Preserve this person's recognizable facial proportions, face shape, age, expression, natural asymmetry, hairstyle and visible accessories. Keep the complete head and a natural short neck. Remove shoulders, chest, clothing and pedestal; retain the full visible length of long hair. Do not crop the crown, chin or hair tips.

## 四视图开头

> Edit this exact four-view head sheet into four views of the SAME finely sanded, cast neutral-gray resin sculpture. Preserve identity, facial proportions, age, expression, four camera angles, short neck, accessories, hairline, hairstyle silhouette, flow and asymmetry. Keep the exact 2x2 layout: FRONT upper left, CAMERA-LEFT profile with nose pointing RIGHT upper right, BACK lower left, CAMERA-RIGHT profile with nose pointing LEFT lower right. Match head scale and retain each complete head and neck. Do not rotate, mirror, reorder or independently redesign the views. Keep the existing aligned crop and a thin central cross gutter.

分离的四张图也可整体作为编辑输入，但应按宿主支持的输出方式交付；上述排版句只用于实际要输出拼图的场景。单张侧面逐图编辑时，改成保持该张明确视角，不附“转正”句。

## 通用正文

> Highest priorities: smooth molded resin skin, coherent broad solid sculpted hair, and a clear dimensional cast-resin appearance. Preserve recognizable anatomy and age; do not beautify, rejuvenate or substitute a template face.
>
> SKIN: Remove pores, pebbled texture, fine wrinkle networks, crosshatching, crackle, tiny creases and noisy microrelief from cheeks, chin, forehead and neck. Rebuild these surfaces as smooth continuous broad anatomical planes. Retain only the principal age-defining expression folds appropriate to this person, such as main forehead folds, nasolabial folds and major neck folds, with rounded softened edges. Retain tissue sagging and face shape. Do not engrave dense lines to communicate age.
>
> HAIR: Replace dense fine fibers with broad flattened overlapping solid locks connected into ONE molded volume. Each lock has a generous uninterrupted smooth surface, with only a FEW broad shallow incised directional grooves. Fuse fine adjacent ridges completely. At ordinary viewing distance see the hairstyle silhouette and broad flowing layers FIRST. No strand bundles made of many thin ridges, no fine parallel lines, spiky tips, individual strands, wisps, flyaways, hair cards or comb-tooth edges. Apply equally to crown, part roots, temples, ear margins, rear hair and nape. Simplify inside the original hair volume: preserve parting, hairline, length, curl and silhouette; do not puff up, add hair, make inflated petals or tubes, or create a helmet rim or facial shell. Keep graceful asymmetrical flowing masses and rounded connected tips. Preserve bald areas; stubble stays nearly flush with the skin, never bristly. Eyebrows and existing short facial hair are extremely shallow continuous relief, not thick locks or individual hairs; preserve their original shape and coverage.
>
> MATERIAL AND EYES: Uniform neutral mid-gray fine resin throughout head, hair, eyes, neck and retained accessories. Soft low-gloss broad light response, not chalk, stone, wax or metal. Every visible eyeball is a smooth gently outward-convex gray spherical surface: no pupil or iris marks, circles, grooves, protruding discs, central holes or indentations, and no corneal highlight or bright spot. Keep eyelid anatomy, eye opening and position. No fragile individual eyelashes.
>
> Soft broad studio illumination gently reveals volume and shallow cuts, with restrained ambient occlusion and a clean pale-gray background. No harsh highlights, black crevices, labels or watermark. This is a dimensional finished resin sculpture, not a desaturated photograph.

## 仍然过碎时的定向修订

只对已经检查出此问题的版本追加，其他身份、视角和构图约束保持：

> The current reference is still too fibrous and skin-textured. Make a decisive surface simplification: eliminate the remaining networks of fine skin creases and fuse adjacent hair ridges into fewer, broader continuous surfaces. Leave generous smooth resin areas between a few shallow carved flow grooves. Preserve the original silhouette and volume; do not achieve simplification by inflating locks or thickening the hairline. Keep the principal age-defining folds and recognizable anatomy.

过度光滑导致年龄/身份变化时，恢复**主要褶皱和组织松弛**，不恢复毛孔和密集细纹；头发过度膨胀时压回原有体积并减浅分割，不恢复成毛丝。检查方法和交付要求见 [操作契约](guide.md)。
